Item 1. Business

The company is engaged in the business of providing financial data and analytics services. It operates in multiple segments including data services, analytics, and consulting. The company serves institutional clients across various asset classes including equities, fixed income, derivatives, and alternative investments. The business has grown substantially over the past decade through organic growth and strategic acquisitions in key markets. Additional information about operations and strategy is included in subsequent sections of this annual report on Form 10-K filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

The company faces numerous risk factors that could materially affect its financial condition and results of operations. These risks include market risks, operational risks, regulatory risks, and technology risks. Competition in the financial data industry is intense, and the company must continuously invest in product development to maintain its competitive position. Economic downturns may reduce demand for premium data services. Regulatory changes in key jurisdictions could require significant compliance investments and may restrict certain business activities. Cybersecurity threats represent a growing concern and the company has invested substantially in information security infrastructure to mitigate these risks going forward.

Item 1B. Unresolved Staff Comments

The company has no unresolved comments from the Securities and Exchange Commission staff regarding its periodic or current reports filed under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. This section is included for disclosure purposes as required by the applicable regulations. All prior SEC review comments have been resolved to the satisfaction of the Commission staff. The company maintains an ongoing dialogue with regulators to ensure full compliance with all applicable reporting requirements and disclosure obligations under the federal securities laws.

Item 2. Properties

The company leases approximately 250,000 square feet of office space in major financial centers including New York, London, Hong Kong, and Singapore. The principal executive offices are located at 1 Financial Plaza, New York, NY. The company does not own significant real property. Leases are generally structured on multi-year terms with renewal options. The company believes its current facilities are adequate for its present needs and anticipated growth over the next several years. Future space requirements will be evaluated in connection with strategic planning.

Revenue increased 14% year-over-year driven by strong growth in the analytics segment. Net income margin improved to 15% from 14.8% in the prior year. The company returned $300 million to shareholders through share repurchases and dividends during fiscal year 2023. Capital expenditures totaled $85 million focused on technology infrastructure upgrades.

ITEM 7A. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk

The company is exposed to market risks in the ordinary course of business. These market risks include interest rate risk, foreign currency exchange rate risk, and equity price risk. The company uses derivative financial instruments to manage certain of these risks. A 100 basis point increase in interest rates would not have a material impact on the company's financial statements given the current structure of its debt and investment portfolios. Foreign currency risk is managed through natural hedging and selective use of forward contracts where appropriate.
